answer_1.quote: Text-to-image generation , as a benchmark task to test AI systems' multi-modal capability, has been widely studied over the past decade. The task takes a short sentence or phrase as input and outputs a single image illustrating the content of the input text.

answer_2.quote: We adopt the automatic evaluation metrics following existing works of the story visualization task and report results using the evaluation script provided in prior work.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation by asking workers to rank the visualizations from all compared models in terms of their visual quality and character preservation.
answer_4.guideline: We ask workers to focus on the image quality and check whether the objects and the background are clear. ... workers are requested to focus on the characters mentioned following the order of story sentences/paragraphs, and judge whether these characters appear in the image sequences.
